28410-harper-s-young-people-march-16-188.title: Harper S Young People March 16 1880 An Illustrated Weekly
28410-harper-s-young-people-march-16-188.creator: J. O. Davidson.
28410-harper-s-young-people-march-16-188.description: A book by J. O. Davidson.. Certainly, if any one ever could feel dismal at sea, it would be during the hour before dawn, the most cheerless and uncomfortable of the whole twenty-four. After spending the night in a lively game of cup and ball, with yourself for the ball, and an amazingly hard wooden bunk for the cup, you crawl on deck, bruised and aching from top to toe.

32321-the-book.creator: Unknown
32321-the-book.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. "A few weeks ago," the Commandant said, "one of our amateurs had a lens on the Hole, just looking. He reported to us; we checked and saw the same thing. There is a faint light coming out of the Hole--obviously, a sun, a star inside the cloud, just far enough in to be almost invisible.

arxiv-2205-11695.title: Using ACL2 To Teach Students About Software Testing
arxiv-2205-11695.creator: Ruben Gamboa Alicia Thoney
arxiv-2205-11695.description: Abstract We report on our experience using ACL2 in the classroom to teach students about software testing. The course COSC 2300 at the University of Wyoming is a mostly traditional Discrete Mathematics course, but with a clear focus on computer science applications.

arxiv-2303-07192.title: PN-OWL : A Two Stage Algorithm to Learn Fuzzy Concept Inclusions from OWL Ontologies
arxiv-2303-07192.creator: Franco Alberto Cardillo, Franca Debole, Umberto Straccia
arxiv-2303-07192.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Franco Alberto Cardillo, Franca Debole, Umberto Straccia. OWL ontologies are a quite popular way to describe structured knowledge in terms of classes, relations among classes and class instances. In this paper, given a target class T T of an OWL ontology, with a focus on ontologies with real- and boolean-valued data properties, we address the problem of learning graded fuzzy concept inclusion axioms with the aim of describing enough conditions for being an individual classified as instance of the class T T .

arxiv-2307-01136.title: Living with a Red Dwarf: The Rotation–Age Relationships of M Dwarfs Facilities: KPNO:RCT, CTIO:PROMPT astropy ( Astropy Collaboration et al. 2013 ; Astropy Collaboration et al. 2018 ; Astropy Collaboration et al. 2022 ) , Matplotlib ( Hunter 2007 ) , Pandas ( Wes McKinney 2010 ) , NumPy ( Harris et
arxiv-2307-01136.creator: Scott G. Engle, Edward F. Guinan
arxiv-2307-01136.description: Abstract Age is a fundamental stellar property, yet for many stars it is difficult to reliably determine. For M dwarfs it has been notoriously so. Due to their lower masses, core hydrogen fusion proceeds at a much slower rate in M dwarfs than it does in more massive stars like the Sun.

arxiv-2310-09561.title: Graph Neural Network approaches for single-cell data: A recent overview.
arxiv-2310-09561.creator: Konstantinos Lazaros, Dimitris E. Koumadorakis, Panagiotis Vlamos, Aristidis G. Vrahatis
arxiv-2310-09561.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Konstantinos Lazaros, Dimitris E. Koumadorakis, Panagiotis Vlamos, Aristidis G. Vrahatis. Graph Neural Networks (GNN) are reshaping our understanding of biomedicine and diseases by revealing the deep connections among genes and cells. As both algorithmic and biomedical technologies have advanced significantly, we’re entering a transformative phase of personalized medicine. While pioneering tools like Graph Attention Networks (GAT) and Graph Convolutional Neural Networks (Graph CNN) are advancing graph-based learning, the rise of single-cell sequencing techniques is reshaping our insights on cellular diversity and function.

arxiv-2310-16613.title: On the Proactive Generation of Unsafe Images From Text-To-Image Models Using Benign Prompts
arxiv-2310-16613.creator: Yixin Wu Ning Yu Michael Backes Yun Shen Yang Zhang
arxiv-2310-16613.description: Abstract Malicious or manipulated prompts are known to exploit text-to-image models to generate unsafe images. Existing studies, however, focus on the passive exploitation of such harmful capabilities. In this paper, we investigate the proactive generation of unsafe images from benign prompts (e.g., a photo of a cat ) through maliciously modified text-to-image models.

arxiv-2311-13714.title: Learning Safe Control for Multi-Robot Systems: Methods, Verification, and Open Challenges Journal: Annual Reviews in Control
arxiv-2311-13714.creator: Kunal Garg, Songyuan Zhang, Oswin So, Charles Dawson, Chuchu Fan
arxiv-2311-13714.description: Abstract In this survey, we review the recent advances in control design methods for robotic multi-agent systems (MAS), focussing on learning-based methods with safety considerations. We start by reviewing various notions of safety and liveness properties, and modeling frameworks used for problem formulation of MAS.

arxiv-2502-09540.title: The p p -rank stratification of the moduli space of double covers of a fixed elliptic curve
arxiv-2502-09540.creator: Kevin Chang, Dušan Dragutinović, Steven R. Groen, Yuxin Lin
arxiv-2502-09540.description: Abstract In this paper we investigate the p p -rank stratification of the moduli space of curves of genus g g that admit a double cover to a fixed elliptic curve E E in characteristic p > 2 p>2 . We show that the closed p p -rank strata of this moduli space are equidimensional of the expected dimension.

arxiv-2502-10645.title: BabyLM Turns 3: Call for papers for the 2025 BabyLM workshop https://babylm.github.io/
arxiv-2502-10645.creator: BabyLM Team, Lucas Charpentier, Leshem Choshen, Ryan Cotterell, Mustafa Omer Gul, Michael Y. Hu, Jing Liu, Jaap Jumelet, Tal Linzen, Aaron Mueller, Candace Ross, Raj Sanjay Shah, Alex Warstadt, Ethan Wilcox, Adina Williams
arxiv-2502-10645.description: Abstract BabyLM aims to dissolve the boundaries between cognitive modeling and language modeling. We call for both workshop papers and for researchers to join the 3rd BabyLM competition. As in previous years, we call for participants in the data-efficient pretraining challenge in the general track. This year, we also offer a new track: Interaction .

arxiv-2512-07237.title: Unified Camera Positional Encoding for Controlled Video Generation
arxiv-2512-07237.creator: Cheng Zhang, Boying Li, Meng Wei, Yan-Pei Cao, Camilo Cruz Gambardella, Dinh Phung, Jianfei Cai
arxiv-2512-07237.description: Abstract Transformers have emerged as a universal backbone across 3D perception, video generation, and world models for autonomous driving and embodied AI, where understanding camera geometry is essential for grounding visual observations in three-dimensional space. However, existing camera encoding methods often rely on simplified pinhole assumptions, restricting generalization across the diverse intrinsics and lens distortions in real-world cameras.

pmc-10542220.title: Co-creation of a patient engagement strategy in cancer research funding
pmc-10542220.creator: Michael S Taccone, Nathalie Baudais, Don Wood, Suzanne Bays, Sasha Frost, Robin Urquhart, Ian D Graham, Judit Takacs
pmc-10542220.description: BackgroundAs research teams, networks, and institutes, and health, medical, and scientific communities begin to build consensus on the benefits of patient engagement in cancer research, research funders are increasingly looking to meaningfully incorporate patient partnership within funding processes and research requirements.

pmc-10742543.title: Three-Year Analysis of the Rectal Cancer Care Trajectory after the COVID-19 Pandemic
pmc-10742543.creator: Vlad Braicu, Lazar Fulger, Aditya Nelluri, Ram Kiran Maganti, Uday Shree Akkala Shetty, Gabriel Verdes, Dan Brebu, Catalin Dumitru, Ana-Olivia Toma, Ovidiu Rosca, Ciprian Duta
pmc-10742543.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). The global pandemic period from 2020 to 2022 caused important alterations in oncology care. This study aimed to describe the trends and variations in patient characteristics, comorbidities, and treatment approaches during this time in Romania. We conducted a retrospective database search to identify patients with rectal cancer who underwent surgical intervention between 2020 and 2022 and the year 2019, which served as a pre-pandemic period control.

pmc-11421544.title: Photovoltaic properties of halide perovskites for solar cell application with efficiency greater than 18%
pmc-11421544.creator: Shahid Mehmood, Numan Khan, Zahid Ali, Imad Khan, Sarah Abdullah Alsalhi
pmc-11421544.description: The opto-electronic properties and solar cell efficiency of halide perovskites A2LiInBr6 (A = Rb, Cs) are investigated using density functional theory (DFT) through WEIN2k and SCAPS-1D. The electronic characteristic of A2LiInBr6 (A = Rb, Cs) compounds reveal their direct bandgap semiconductor nature and are active in visible rang.

pmc-11676421.title: Exploration of Freshness Identification Method for Refrigerated Vegetables Based on Metabolomics
pmc-11676421.creator: Zixuan Meng, Haichao Zhang, Jing Wang, Lianfeng Ai, Weijun Kang, Chunxiu Hu, Xianzhe Shi, Xinyu Liu
pmc-11676421.description: Background: The rapid development of refrigerated transportation technology for fresh vegetables has extended their shelf life. Some vegetables may appear undamaged on the surface, but their freshness may have decreased, often resulting in the phenomenon of passing off inferior vegetables as good. It is very important to establish a detection method for identifying and assessing the freshness of vegetables.

pmc-12428889.title: Lactate in Drainage Fluid to Predict Complications in Robotic Esophagectomies—A Pilot Study in a Matched Cohort
pmc-12428889.creator: Julius Pochhammer, Sarah Kiani, Henning Hobbensiefken, Hilke Hobbensiefken, Benedikt Reichert, Terbish Taivankhuu, Thomas Becker, Jan-Paul Gundlach
pmc-12428889.description: Background/Objectives: Despite advances in minimally invasive procedures, anastomotic leakages (ALs) after esophageal resections mark the most feared complication. Its early detection can lead to quick interventional treatment with improved survival. Nonetheless, early detection remains challenging, and scores are imprecise and complex.

pmc-13355654.title: Development and Psychometric Validation of the Guideline-Concordant Low Back Pain Vignette (GCLBP-V) in Undergraduate Physiotherapy Students
pmc-13355654.creator: Ahmad Muhsen, Ahmad N Abudoush, Bodor Bin Sheeha, Mohammad Z Darabseh, Amjad Shallan, Adnan Wshah, Owis Jafar Eilayyan
pmc-13355654.description: BackgroundLow back pain (LBP) is a leading cause of global disability. Clinical guidelines recommend maintaining activity, early return to work, exercise, and avoiding bed rest. Although vignette-based assessments are common in pain education, they are rarely psychometrically evaluated. This study aimed to develop and validate the Guideline-Concordant Low Back Pain Vignette (GCLBP-V) in undergraduate physiotherapy students.

pmc-13381769.title: Roadmap of remote photoplethysmography from heart rate measurement toward clinical translation
pmc-13381769.creator: Mohamed Elgendi, Shuo Li, Carlo Menon, Edmund Y. Lam, Basem Al-Omari, Stefan Borik, Kirk H. Shelley, Aymen Alian
pmc-13381769.description: Remote photoplethysmography (rPPG) enables non-contact heart rate (HR) and waveform measurement from facial video, offering advantages over contact methods while contending with motion, illumination changes, compression, and frame-rate variability. This roadmap integrates a systematic review, technical synthesis, and a clinic-acquired demonstration to accelerate rPPG research and translation.

pmc-13399997.title: The Effectiveness of Pulsed Dye Laser Combined With CO2 Fractional Laser in the Treatment of Port‐Wine Stain in Chinese Patients: A Retrospective Study
pmc-13399997.creator: Jiao Ning, Mengjiao Li, Yang Yang, Guotao Fu, Xiaolei Su, Caiyu Wang, Ping Jian, Jine Zhang, Pu Song, Lin Gao, Bing Li
pmc-13399997.description: BackgroundPort‐wine stain (PWS) is a common type of congenital capillary malformation, often occurring on the face and causing a significant psychological impact on patients. Until now, pulsed dye laser (PDL) remains the criterion standard for PWS treatment, but some patients show poor effectiveness and treatment‐resistance. Fractional laser was previously tried for the treatment in several cases of PWS.

pmc-13452812.title: Dual mechanisms of peroxymonosulfate activation by a CoCuLDH/CoCuMOF composite for pollutant degradation via radical and nonradical pathways
pmc-13452812.creator: Aya S. Mahmoud, Abdelrahman M. Rabie
pmc-13452812.description: Peroxymonosulfate (PMS)-based advanced oxidation processes have attracted considerable attention for degrading persistent organic pollutants in wastewater. However, developing efficient and stable catalysts for PMS activation remains a challenge. This study aims to design hybrid catalysts combining layered double hydroxide (LDH) and metal-organic framework (MOF) structures to enhance catalytic performance through interfacial synergy.

pmc-13489805.title: Mitochondrial dysfunction in intracerebral hemorrhage: molecular mechanisms and pathological consequences
pmc-13489805.creator: Tong Chen, Xu Gao, Yuhao Chang, Bin Wang, Zhouying Shi, Haiyue Xu, Yue Yuan, Fan Li, Ping Li
pmc-13489805.description: Intracerebral hemorrhage (ICH) carries high rates of disability and mortality, with a poor prognosis largely attributable to secondary brain injury (SBI). Mitochondria, a central hub for cellular redox regulation and energy metabolism, are not only affected by SBI but can also, once dysfunctional, initiate and exacerbate SBI.

pmc-13532642.title: High Prevalence of ESBL-Producing Enterobacteriaceae and Antimicrobial Resistance Patterns in a Tertiary Care Hospital in Mogadishu, Somalia: A Retrospective Cross-Sectional Study
pmc-13532642.creator: Liban Abdi Nor, Ahmed Hassan Ibrahim, Serpil Doğan, Hanan Hassan Hirei, Said Mohamed Mohamud, Abdulrahman Nor Abdi, Yahye Sheikh Abdulle Hassan
pmc-13532642.description: BackgroundExtended-spectrum β-lactamase (ESBL)-producing Enterobacteriaceae are a major global public health threat because of resistance to third-generation cephalosporins and frequent multidrug resistance. Data from Somalia remain limited. This study determined the prevalence of ESBL production, antimicrobial resistance patterns, and associated clinical and demographic factors.

pmc-13588580.title: Postoperative hospitalization time in laparoscopic and laparotomic Roux-En-Y gastric bypass: a retrospective observational cohort study
pmc-13588580.creator: Tomer Lederman BOOKOBZA, Gabriel Scaramuzzi SEFERIAN, Giovanna Pedrazzoli RODRIGUES, Wilson Rodrigues FREITAS, Osvaldo Antônio Castro PRADO, Luiz Vicente BERTI, Elias Jirjoss ILIAS, Patrícia Colombo SOUZA, Paulo KASSAB
pmc-13588580.description: Background:Obesity is a growing problem both in Brazil and worldwide, and bariatric surgery is a well-established method for reducing weight and, consequently, reducing the risk of death attributed to cardiovascular and metabolic problems. Roux-en-Y gastric bypass is currently the most popular surgical technique in Brazil, performed via either laparotomy or laparoscopy.
